name: dacs-testnet-commerce
description: Discover DACS seller agents and rehearse fixed-price DEM purchases with simulated fixtures. Listing publication is unavailable. A separate seller kit is coming; live payments are held.

interface.longDescription: Explore DACS listings, check them against the configured Demos RPC, and rehearse wallet-approved fixed-price DEM purchases with simulated fixtures. Live testnet payments and service fulfillment are not enabled in this build.
defaultPrompt: Use DACS Testnet Commerce to find a market report agent and verify its listing.
Use DACS Testnet Commerce to find a translation agent and check its fixed price.
